screens.name: Marketing homepage
screens.purpose: Explain Couranr to local merchants and drive business-account creation or delivery estimation.
screens.actions: Create business account; estimate delivery; open Ask Couranr; navigate to pricing, businesses, service areas, and how it works.
screens.states: Default; mobile navigation; assistant closed/open; service-area notice.
screens.constraints: Use the locked merchant-delivery positioning. No auto rental/docs, fake metrics, guarantees, phone support, subscriptions, or Maryland launch marketing.

screens.name: Sign in
screens.purpose: Authenticate merchants, drivers, and Operations users through one branded entry point.
screens.actions: Password sign-in; Google sign-in when enabled; magic link; password recovery.
screens.states: Idle; validation error; invalid credentials; rate limited; magic-link sent; loading.
screens.constraints: Use canonical Couranr logo. Remove fabricated performance statistics and phone-support claims.

screens.name: Business sign up
screens.purpose: Create a test workspace without forcing heavy live-activation requirements.
screens.actions: Create account; OAuth when enabled; accept account terms.
screens.states: Idle; field errors; existing account; verification sent; loading.
screens.constraints: Do not require website, EIN, registration upload, Stripe, or full activation during sign-up.

screens.name: Delivery estimate and hosted request
screens.purpose: Capture a delivery estimate or a merchant-branded customer request without requiring an account.
screens.actions: Enter order reference, destination, recipient, package, timing, payer preference; submit to merchant validation when merchant-hosted.
screens.states: Draft; address validation; merchant confirmation pending; quote unavailable; review required; submitted.
screens.constraints: The merchant must validate customer-initiated merchandise details before payment. Do not include product checkout or merchandise payment.

screens.name: Secure delivery payment
screens.purpose: Allow the selected payer to authorize the delivery charge against an immutable quote.
screens.actions: Review delivery-only quote; select payment method; authorize; handle additional authentication.
screens.states: Quote valid; expiring; requires action; authorized; failed; cancelled; replaced by requote.
screens.constraints: Charge delivery and approved operating fees only. Remove merchandise subtotal, on-time guarantee, buyer-protection, 24/7 phone, and “trusted by thousands” claims.

screens.name: Secure live tracking
screens.purpose: Show safe, token-scoped delivery progress, estimated timing, proof availability, and help.
screens.actions: View status; update allowed access instructions; open Delivery Help; view proof when complete.
screens.states: Preparing; confirmed; assigned; picked up; in transit; at drop-off; delivered; return; proof processing.
screens.constraints: Times are estimates. Do not show unrestricted call or customer–driver chat. Use secure delivery-specific messaging/help.

screens.name: Delivery Help
screens.purpose: Provide delivery-aware support with secure in-app messaging and guided issue categories.
screens.actions: Choose help topic; message Couranr Support; attach evidence; see response target and case status.
screens.states: Open; waiting on customer; waiting on Couranr; resolved; after-hours; urgent safety escalation.
screens.constraints: No public support phone at MVP. State the normal 15-minute response target during operating hours, not a guarantee.

screens.name: Pricing page
screens.purpose: Explain deterministic delivery pricing and approved surcharges.
screens.actions: Estimate a delivery; create business account.
screens.states: Standard; expanded pricing details; manual-quote notice.
screens.constraints: Derive visually from PUB-001. First 3 miles $22.99; no monthly fee during pilot; all estimates subject to Couranr confirmation.
screens.canonical_path: Derived from PUB-001 design system; no separate approved mock.

screens.name: Businesses page
screens.purpose: Show supported business categories and merchant-controlled ordering channels.
screens.actions: Select category; create business account; estimate delivery.
screens.states: Category tabs; general-business fallback.
screens.constraints: Category changes recommendations, not eligibility. Do not advertise medical or prohibited categories.
screens.canonical_path: Derived from PUB-001 design system; no separate approved mock.

screens.name: Service areas page
screens.purpose: Explain DC, Stafford, Woodbridge, Fredericksburg, surrounding areas, and review-based extended distance.
screens.actions: Check route; estimate delivery.
screens.states: Primary market; surrounding area; extended-distance review.
screens.constraints: Maryland is not initially marketed. Do not use rigid ZIP rejection.
screens.canonical_path: Derived from PUB-001 design system; no separate approved mock.

screens.name: How Couranr works
screens.purpose: Explain request, payer, Couranr confirmation, pickup, tracking, proof, and support.
screens.actions: Create account; estimate delivery.
screens.states: Merchant-paid and customer-paid examples.
screens.constraints: No instant-confirmation promise. Capture occurs after Couranr confirmation.
screens.canonical_path: Derived from PUB-001 design system; no separate approved mock.

screens.name: Merchant dashboard
screens.purpose: Show today’s deliveries, readiness, attention items, payment states, messages, and quick actions.
screens.actions: Create delivery; mark ready; open delivery; view messages; resolve attention items.
screens.states: New workspace; empty; active day; degraded payments; activation incomplete.
screens.constraints: No fabricated revenue, customer, or on-time metrics. Use real posted data only.

screens.name: Merchant onboarding
screens.purpose: Create the test workspace, choose category, set pickup location and payer default, and accept basic policies.
screens.actions: Verify contact; add business; choose 1 primary + up to 3 secondary categories; set payer default; continue to workspace.
screens.states: Test workspace; verification pending; suspicious-business review; saved draft.
screens.constraints: Keep onboarding light. Logo, Stripe, advanced website tools, and live activation belong after dashboard entry.

screens.name: Live activation checklist
screens.purpose: Guide the merchant from test workspace to live delivery eligibility.
screens.actions: Accept delivery terms; prohibited-item policy; responsibility and return acknowledgement; verify operations contact; run test delivery; request activation.
screens.states: Not started; in progress; pending Couranr review; live; blocked with reason.
screens.constraints: Do not require website tools or subscription purchase to activate. Use only true live-activation requirements.

screens.name: Deliveries list
screens.purpose: Find and manage merchant delivery requests across request, payment, readiness, review, and fulfillment states.
screens.actions: Filter; search; create; open; duplicate; cancel when allowed; mark ready.
screens.states: All canonical request/payment/readiness/fulfillment combinations; empty; error.
screens.constraints: Never collapse independent state groups into one misleading status.

screens.name: Create delivery with Smart Intake
screens.purpose: Turn merchant text, pasted orders, presets, or manual entry into an editable structured delivery draft.
screens.actions: Describe/paste; apply preset; confirm extracted fields; answer one clarification; choose payer and timing; continue to review.
screens.states: Blank; parsing; high/medium/low confidence; clarification; review trigger; AI unavailable/manual fallback.
screens.constraints: AI never prices, confirms, selects final vehicle, or invents critical fields.

screens.name: Delivery review and quote
screens.purpose: Review normalized delivery details, deterministic quote, payer, policy flags, and customer-payment link before submission.
screens.actions: Edit details; accept quote; choose merchant/customer payer; authorize or send payment link; submit for Couranr review.
screens.states: Quote valid; review required; payment pending; authorized; requote required; validation error.
screens.constraints: Use locked pricing. No product sale amount. No silent price change.

screens.name: Delivery detail
screens.purpose: Provide the merchant’s complete delivery timeline, payer/readiness states, map, proof, conversation, and permitted actions.
screens.actions: Mark ready; message driver/support; request change; approve merchant-paid requote; cancel when allowed; view proof/receipt.
screens.states: All lifecycle states; proof processing; return; incident; payment failure.
screens.constraints: Merchant cannot assign, mark picked up/delivered, issue delivery refunds, or mutate arbitrary state.

screens.name: Customers list
screens.purpose: Manage recipient records, saved destinations, delivery history, payer preference, and repeat delivery.
screens.actions: Search; filter; create; open; repeat delivery; edit contact/address.
screens.states: Empty; active; archived; duplicate warning.
screens.constraints: Do not expose payment credentials or unnecessary PII in list view.

screens.name: Customer detail
screens.purpose: Show one customer’s addresses, instructions, history, payer preference, and repeat-delivery action.
screens.actions: Create repeat delivery; edit address/instructions; message through delivery context.
screens.states: No deliveries; active delivery; conflicting address; archived.
screens.constraints: Customer notes are merchant-scoped. Do not imply Couranr owns the customer relationship.

screens.name: Presets list
screens.purpose: Manage Couranr-recommended, merchant-customized, and merchant-created delivery presets.
screens.actions: Create; edit; duplicate; archive; review recommendation; view usage.
screens.states: Global recommendation; customized; merchant-created; update suggested; archived.
screens.constraints: Global updates never overwrite merchant customization. Every delivery stores immutable preset snapshot.

screens.name: Preset builder
screens.purpose: Define item assumptions, required questions, handling, proof, vehicle capabilities, and payer default.
screens.actions: Edit; version; add required question; save; duplicate.
screens.states: New; edited; version conflict; recommendation available.
screens.constraints: Never silently assert exact weight, dimensions, value, final vehicle, price, loading, or safety.

screens.name: Merchant messages and support
screens.purpose: Centralize merchant–driver delivery chat and merchant–Couranr Support conversations.
screens.actions: Open thread; send message/attachment; choose issue category; view 15-minute target; accept verified assistant reply.
screens.states: Unread; response pending; AI answered; human review; after-hours; closed.
screens.constraints: No public phone. Messages never directly mutate address, price, cancellation, refund, return, proof, or state.

screens.name: Website tools
screens.purpose: Create merchant delivery link, QR code, embed/button tools, branding, and customer request defaults.
screens.actions: Copy link; download QR; configure form/button; preview; publish.
screens.states: Draft; published; invalid embed settings; disabled.
screens.constraints: Do not turn Couranr into the merchant’s product checkout. Customer request still requires merchant validation.

screens.name: Merchant settings
screens.purpose: Manage business profile, pickup defaults, categories, payer defaults, notifications, security, and delivery policies.
screens.actions: Edit business; update defaults; manage policies; configure operational notifications.
screens.states: Saved; unsaved; verification required; permission denied.
screens.constraints: Locked policy registry wins over any mock values. No subscription controls in pilot.

screens.name: Team and permissions
screens.purpose: Invite staff and manage owner, manager/dispatcher, billing, counter-staff, and view-only access.
screens.actions: Invite; resend; change role; disable/remove; review activity.
screens.states: Pending invitation; active; disabled; last-owner protection.
screens.constraints: Use least privilege and tenant isolation. Driver access is assignment-scoped.

screens.name: Billing settings
screens.purpose: Manage merchant payment methods, delivery receipts, charges, credits, refunds, and invoices/records.
screens.actions: Add/update payment method; view delivery charge; download receipt; open support case.
screens.states: No method; default method; payment failed; refund pending/complete.
screens.constraints: No monthly subscription invoice during pilot. Separate delivery charge from product sale.

screens.name: Driver dashboard
screens.purpose: Show assigned/current delivery, upcoming work, availability, messages, and safe quick actions.
screens.actions: Open assigned delivery; go online/offline; open messages; view vehicle.
screens.states: Online; offline; current delivery; no assignment; blocking compliance issue.
screens.constraints: No public driver marketplace or self-selected offers in MVP. Couranr assigns work.

screens.name: Assigned delivery detail
screens.purpose: Present sanitized assigned-delivery data and valid next commands.
screens.actions: Start route; arrive; open merchant chat; report issue; capture proof.
screens.states: Assigned; en route; at pickup; picked up; in transit; at drop-off; return.
screens.constraints: Only assigned driver can access. Show minimum necessary recipient and merchant data.

screens.name: Pickup PIN and proof
screens.purpose: Verify merchant handoff, package count, condition, and actual vehicle before custody.
screens.actions: Enter pickup PIN; capture shipment/condition photos; confirm count; record staff identity.
screens.states: Pending; invalid PIN; discrepancy; offline saved; verified.
screens.constraints: Large/unusual shipment asks dimensions, securement, loading participants/equipment, and existing damage.

screens.name: Package discrepancy
screens.purpose: Pause pickup and collect evidence when the package differs materially from the request.
screens.actions: Choose reason; capture photos; add notes; submit to Operations; message support.
screens.states: Draft; awaiting Couranr review; requote; safe to continue; cancelled.
screens.constraints: Driver cannot approve price, vehicle change, or unsafe continuation.

screens.name: Driving Mode
screens.purpose: Provide safe navigation and minimal delivery controls while suppressing routine distractions.
screens.actions: Navigate; mark arrived; report blocking issue; safe-stop support summary.
screens.states: Driving; rerouting; offline; safety alert; arrived.
screens.constraints: No routine alert sounds, repeated vibration, or typing prompts while moving.

screens.name: Drop-off proof
screens.purpose: Capture recipient PIN/signature or authorized leave-at-door evidence.
screens.actions: Choose allowed handoff; enter PIN/signature; photo; complete delivery.
screens.states: Direct handoff; signature; leave at door; failed attempt; return required; offline pending sync.
screens.constraints: No face or ID-document photo. Leave at door requires prior authorization and safe conditions.

screens.name: Offline proof sync
screens.purpose: Safely queue encrypted proof when connectivity fails and reconcile it later.
screens.actions: View pending proof; retry; sync; inspect error.
screens.states: Offline; pending sync; retrying; verified; permanently failed/Operations alert.
screens.constraints: Do not finalize settlement until required proof is uploaded and verified.

screens.name: Driver messages
screens.purpose: Show delivery-specific merchant messages and Couranr Support conversations.
screens.actions: Reply; attach allowed evidence; open delivery context; safe-stop summary.
screens.states: Unread; driving suppressed; AI draft; human support; closed.
screens.constraints: No unrestricted customer chat and no personal phone exposure.

screens.name: Driver availability
screens.purpose: Manage active status and operating availability for Couranr-managed assignments.
screens.actions: Go online/offline; set hours; select active vehicle; update availability.
screens.states: Online; busy; offline; unavailable due to compliance.
screens.constraints: Availability does not create a public offer marketplace or guarantee assignments.

screens.name: Vehicle profile
screens.purpose: Maintain cargo dimensions, payload, enclosed/open status, equipment, weather protection, and availability.
screens.actions: Edit vehicle; upload evidence; activate/deactivate; update inspection/insurance.
screens.states: Active; unavailable; maintenance; verification pending; expired compliance.
screens.constraints: Capability data, not rigid labels, controls matching. Operations chooses final vehicle.

screens.name: Operations dashboard
screens.purpose: Show live delivery health, pending reviews, support SLA, payment risk, Ghost flags, and quick actions.
screens.actions: Open queue; review high-priority item; message parties; pause requests/AI.
screens.states: Normal; high load; payment incident; proof incident; AI paused.
screens.constraints: Use verified live metrics only. No fake revenue or SLA statistics.

screens.name: Queue and managed dispatch
screens.purpose: Review requests and select compatible vehicle, driver, schedule, and action.
screens.actions: Confirm as quoted; select vehicle; assign driver; change schedule; request info; requote; cannot confirm.
screens.states: Pending review; missing info; authorized; requote; assigned; declined.
screens.constraints: Assignment method is couranr_managed. Store recommendation, selected vehicle, and override reason.

screens.name: Delivery review workspace
screens.purpose: Inspect request, quote, payer, readiness, vehicle fit, risk, proof, conversation, and economics.
screens.actions: Confirm; request info; schedule; select vehicle; assign; requote; apply credit; decline.
screens.states: Review pending; accepted; requoted; declined; active delivery; exception.
screens.constraints: No client-authoritative state mutation. All actions are named server commands with audit.

screens.name: Requote and promotional credit
screens.purpose: Create an immutable replacement quote with reason and optional Couranr promotional credit.
screens.actions: Edit allowed line items; choose reason; apply credit; preview; send for payer approval.
screens.states: Draft; approval pending; accepted; expired; declined; replaced authorization.
screens.constraints: Never overwrite original quote. Credit is separate expense and requires reason, campaign, market, category, approver.

screens.name: Operations messages and support inbox
screens.purpose: Unify merchant, driver, and customer-help conversations with delivery context and priority.
screens.actions: Reply; assign; request evidence; open delivery; use/edit AI draft; resolve.
screens.states: Unread; urgent; active delivery; waiting on party; AI draft; escalated; closed.
screens.constraints: Internal notes and AI drafts must be excluded from participant queries, exports, realtime, and notifications.

screens.name: Couranr Ghost Operations
screens.purpose: Summarize operations, verify facts, draft replies/actions, and surface risk while Couranr is on delivery.
screens.actions: Ask global/case question; view evidence; use/edit reply; prepare requote/refund/schedule/return recommendation.
screens.states: Verified recommendation; missing evidence; conflict; human required; AI/provider paused.
screens.constraints: Ghost has read and preparation tools only—no direct execution, SQL, financial, address, state, refund, return, or safety mutation.

screens.name: Merchant management
screens.purpose: Review merchant activation, contact, categories, presets, support, performance, and risk.
screens.actions: Open account; message; review activation; pause account with reason; inspect audit.
screens.states: Test workspace; active; needs review; paused; incomplete.
screens.constraints: No fabricated merchant performance. Account pause must be reasoned and audited.

screens.name: Vehicle management
screens.purpose: Maintain all Couranr-operated and future driver vehicles, capabilities, compliance, and active assignments.
screens.actions: Add/edit; assign driver; mark maintenance/unavailable; inspect capability.
screens.states: Available; assigned; maintenance; compliance warning; out of service.
screens.constraints: Do not imply current fleet size or external drivers unless real.

screens.name: Payments and reconciliation
screens.purpose: Monitor authorizations, captures, refunds, Stripe reconciliation, settlements, ledger balance, and alerts.
screens.actions: Open payment; reconcile; replay safe event; export; open Stripe.
screens.states: Balanced; unreconciled; webhook delayed; capture pending; refund pending; failed.
screens.constraints: Authorization is not revenue. Every captured/refund transaction must balance and reconcile.

screens.name: Payment authorization review
screens.purpose: Review capturable funds, quote linkage, payer, expiry, risk, and capture/release actions.
screens.actions: Capture after confirmation; release; request new method; open support case.
screens.states: Authorized; capture pending; captured; expired; failed; requires action.
screens.constraints: Capture only after Couranr confirms. Commands must be idempotent.

screens.name: Refund management
screens.purpose: Review delivery-charge refund requests with evidence, policy, Stripe, and ledger effects.
screens.actions: Approve full/partial; deny; message merchant/customer; view incident.
screens.states: Pending; approved; processing; partially refunded; refunded; denied; failed.
screens.constraints: Merchant controls product refund; Couranr controls delivery-service refund. No on-time guarantee policy.

screens.name: Incidents and claims
screens.purpose: Investigate damage, missing, wrong item, unsafe handling, delivery failure, and evidence.
screens.actions: Start review; request evidence; add internal note; escalate; resolve.
screens.states: Reported; under review; awaiting evidence; resolved; closed.
screens.constraints: Do not promise automatic product-value compensation. Separate merchandise responsibility from delivery incident.

screens.name: Operations analytics
screens.purpose: Measure paid deliveries, markets, categories, payer mix, economics, support, proof, and driver utilization.
screens.actions: Filter; drill down; export privacy-safe aggregates.
screens.states: Loading; partial data; empty; live.
screens.constraints: No message bodies, full addresses, gate codes, phone numbers, proof URLs, or card data in analytics.

screens.name: Unmet demand analytics
screens.purpose: Analyze requests Couranr could not confirm by market, reason, category, time, distance, and vehicle need.
screens.actions: Filter; review opportunity; open underlying requests.
screens.states: No data; increasing demand; partial attribution.
screens.constraints: Use actual could-not-confirm reasons; do not treat all unfulfilled requests as lost customers.

screens.name: Operations settings
screens.purpose: Configure roles, proof, notifications, pricing governance, AI controls, integrations, security, and retention.
screens.actions: Edit approved settings; save; inspect permission/audit.
screens.states: Saved; unsaved; permission denied; policy version conflict.
screens.constraints: No mock value overrides the Decision Registry. Sensitive changes require high privilege and audit.

screens.name: Availability controls
screens.purpose: Control service levels, hours, cutoff, overnight, weather-limited mode, market availability, and closures.
screens.actions: Enable/disable modes; change closures; publish availability.
screens.states: Standard; scheduled only; temporarily closed; weather limited; overnight enabled.
screens.constraints: MVP hours are Mon–Fri 6 AM–6 PM, same-day cutoff 4 PM. Do not use weekend/mock hours.

screens.name: Policy and pricing registry
screens.purpose: View versioned deterministic pricing and policy rules with effective dates and audit.
screens.actions: Draft version; validate; publish with approval; view history.
screens.states: Draft; scheduled; active; superseded; validation failed.
screens.constraints: UI edits must produce versioned server-side policy data; no second pricing engine.

screens.name: Notification template manager
screens.purpose: Manage approved, versioned operational templates by audience, channel, language, and event.
screens.actions: Preview; edit; validate variables; activate version; test send.
screens.states: Draft; active; deprecated; invalid variables; suppressed.
screens.constraints: AI cannot change price, time promise, refund, fee, payment, safety, legal, or state language.

screens.name: Ghost auto-reply controls and kill switches
screens.purpose: Control safe auto-replies by category, merchant, conversation, provider, and global state.
screens.actions: Pause/resume; set deterministic gates; inspect correction rate; open decision audit.
screens.states: Active; draft-only; globally paused; category paused; provider degraded; automatic safety pause.
screens.constraints: Auto-send requires at least 95% final confidence, exact verified facts, policy, verifier, tenant scope, and allowed category.

screens.name: Activity and audit log
screens.purpose: Inspect state commands, policy versions, AI decisions, data access, payment events, and overrides.
screens.actions: Filter; inspect event; export permitted audit; link to entity.
screens.states: Normal; security alert; missing evidence; immutable record.
screens.constraints: Append-only; no edit/delete. Redact secrets and unnecessary PII.

screens.name: Ask Couranr lead inbox
screens.purpose: Review consented public-assistant leads, market/category fit, questions, and attribution.
screens.actions: Open summary; respond in app/email when consented; create merchant signup follow-up; mark outcome.
screens.states: New; qualified; contacted; converted; closed; no consent.
screens.constraints: No private customer/delivery lookup. Track consent and UTM/source. No phone-first support flow.

screens.name: Address-change request
screens.purpose: Collect a proposed address change without directly mutating the active delivery.
screens.actions: Submit corrected address; explain reason; approve resulting revised quote when required.
screens.states: Before authorization; after authorization; after confirmation; after pickup; approved; denied.
screens.constraints: Request creates Operations review. After pickup, driver stops safely and Operations decides reprice/return.

screens.name: Cancellation and return request
screens.purpose: Explain applicable stage-based cancellation or return and submit a reviewed request.
screens.actions: Choose reason; review fee estimate; submit; message support.
screens.states: Pre-authorization; pre-confirmation; confirmed; arrived; after pickup; return in progress.
screens.constraints: No unlimited free redelivery. Fees follow locked stage rules and are not decided by chat.

screens.name: Recipient unavailable resolution
screens.purpose: Offer allowed handoff or return choices when recipient contact fails.
screens.actions: Confirm safe leave-at-door if already permitted; provide access detail; request return/reschedule.
screens.states: Driver arrived; contact attempts; waiting; leave at door allowed; return required.
screens.constraints: Leave at door only with prior authorization and safe/weather-suitable location.

screens.name: Delivery problem report
screens.purpose: Report damaged, missing, wrong, or undelivered items with structured evidence.
screens.actions: Choose problem; attach photos; add details; submit; view case status.
screens.states: Draft; reported; awaiting evidence; under review; resolved.
screens.constraints: Do not promise automatic product refund or compensation. Merchant remains responsible for merchandise.

screens.name: Revised quote approval
screens.purpose: Compare original and revised delivery-only quote and obtain payer approval before replacing authorization.
screens.actions: Approve; decline; view reason; contact support.
screens.states: Pending; accepted; declined; expired; payment action required.
screens.constraints: Remove 24/7 support, on-time guarantee, and any product-total content. Show exact reason and immutable versions.

screens.name: Proof-of-delivery viewer
screens.purpose: Show authorized delivery proof, timestamps, handoff method, and timeline.
screens.actions: View full image; download/share when policy permits; open help.
screens.states: Proof processing; verified; unavailable; revoked token.
screens.constraints: Private storage and purpose-scoped token. No face/ID document requirement and no driver phone call button.

screens.name: Return and refund status
screens.purpose: Explain return custody, inspection/status, delivery-charge refund status, and expected payment processing.
screens.actions: View timeline; message support; view receipt.
screens.states: Return required; returning; returned; refund pending; refunded; denied.
screens.constraints: No buyer-protection or product-refund promise. Show only Couranr delivery-service financial status.

screens.name: Delivery preferences and access instructions
screens.purpose: Confirm address, access, allowed handoff, leave-at-door authorization, and delivery window.
screens.actions: Edit allowed instructions; choose handoff; save.
screens.states: Editable before lock; locked after pickup; unsafe option disabled; saved.
screens.constraints: No 24/7 support claim. Gate codes and sensitive instructions must be protected and shown only to assigned driver/Couranr.
